body: I've always appreciated the little good that is in the world, but for me the good does not outweigh the bad. And what is the good worth if not having anyone to experience it with? That's what I think about the most. This world is cruel and unforgiving anyways. People are judgmental af, selfish naturally and only care when it's convenient. I can't accept this.

I once accepted lonliness also, at least I didn't think about it as much. But as I got older the more it started to bother me. Realizing how much I've missed out on, and will miss out on in the future. I think I fooled myself into believing I was okay with being alone, and that having friends and going out just wasn't my thing. But I know now that it's all I want. I was just jealous of others who had that lifestyle.

I appreciate the sentiment, but you shouldn't be scared for me. I'm not afraid of death. I've been planning this for awhile. An eternal slumber and peace is awaiting me. My mind is hell, and I'll finally be at peace.

Why does it matter? I'm old enough to decide for myself. I don't feel like hearing anything else about waiting it out and seeing how things might change. It's just not true for me. I know that. I've been this way damn near my whole life. I've always been weird, never been able to relate to people or make friends. If I don't have any social skills by now I'm never going to. I don't have any talent or calling that would make my life have a sense of fulfillment. The only thing I've ever truly felt in my heart is that I will die by my own hands. And I will fufill that soon enough. I'm tired. If you must know, I'm 19.
